body.description: a big old-world cargo machine twice the size of a Stray, a boxy sun-bleached yellow body on two dusty rubber treads, a forklift arm folded in front like a jaw, a row of three red sensor eyes, a cracked warning beacon on top, dragging chains; it leaves big tracks around the dry lake. no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy

body.action_description: idle: idling, beacon turning, chains swaying
rolling forward on its treads, forklift jaw bobbing
